description: Packaging Design Domain Plugin — declares the 12-step design workflow, 8 artifact types, 7 overlay zone definitions (renderer boundary metadata only), material substrate registry, 6 export presets, and compliance profiles for Indonesian food, cosmetic, and general retail packaging. No CAD/dieline engine. No new DB tables.

routesToMount.note: Mount after packagingDesignRouter (Team 19). Router self-registers /ai/packaging-design-plugin/* (admin) and /ai/packaging-design-plugin/brief/validate (public).

pluginModules.description: Master manifest combining all plugin metadata.
Zod brief schema for all 12 brief fields. Additive — complements Team 19 order schema.
8 packaging artifact type definitions with MIME type and metadata field registry.
7 overlay zone definitions (renderer boundary metadata only — no drawing engine).
Material substrate registry and MaterialContribution builder.
6 export preset definitions (print_ready, client_preview, dieline_source, digital_only, sustainability_pack, full_package).
Compliance profiles for Indonesian food, cosmetic, and general retail packaging. buildComplianceSheet produces an initial compliance sheet with all checks pending.
Barrel export — import all plugin public APIs from this file.

integrationNotes: This plugin is purely additive — it does NOT modify Team 19's packaging_design_orders, packaging_design_variants, or packaging_design_validation_log tables.
Overlay zone IDs (bleed, trim, safe_area, fold, cut, glue_zone, barcode_zone) intentionally match the overlay zones used in Team 19's prepress validation engine for semantic consistency.
The brief schema's `linkedOrderId` field (UUID) allows associating a plugin brief with an existing Team 19 packaging_design_orders record — no foreign key constraint enforced at DB level.
Export preset IDs may be stored in packagingDesignOrder.briefJson.exportPreset to record the client's chosen delivery format.
Compliance sheet metadata may be embedded in packagingDesignOrder.briefJson.complianceSheet — this avoids a new DB table while preserving the structured data.
No migration file is needed — this plugin declares code-level metadata only.
Admin routes require x-admin-api-key (handled by global adminAuthWithExceptions — no per-route duplication needed).
POST /ai/packaging-design-plugin/brief/validate is intentionally public (no auth) — it performs zero writes and exposes no sensitive data.
Team 39 (Integration): mount packagingDesignPluginRouter after packagingDesignRouter in routes/index.ts.
adapterNotes: No adapters to other teams are required. This plugin depends only on Team 19's schema.ts for the PACKAGING_SERVICE_TYPES constant (read-only import).
If Team 19's PACKAGING_SERVICE_TYPES changes, Team 26's brief.ts packagingType enum must be updated to match.

testSummary.dbMocking: not required (no DB calls in plugin)

risks.description: PACKAGING_SERVICE_TYPES imported from Team 19's schema.ts — if Team 19 renames or removes that export, Team 26's brief.ts compile will fail.
risks.mitigation: Document this dependency. If Team 19 ever moves schema.ts, update the import path in brief.ts.

risks.description: compliance.ts RegulatoryBody type is imported as a type-only from brief.ts — circular-import risk if brief.ts later imports from compliance.ts.
risks.mitigation: The import direction is one-way (compliance imports brief type, never the reverse). Enforce this with a lint rule or tsconfig paths if needed.
